partners.mechanism_chain: SOST (HGNC:10967) —DECREASES→ WNT signaling pathway (WP:WP472); WNT signaling pathway (WP:WP472) —INCREASES→ Increased bone density (HP:0000105); WNT1 (HGNC:12801) —DISRUPTS→ WNT signaling pathway (WP:WP472); WNT signaling pathway (WP:WP472) —LEADS_TO→ Skeletal abnormalities (HP:0000924); WNT signaling pathway (WP:WP472) —LEADS_TO→ Intellectual disability (HP:0001249).
